properties.name: grpc.shared-secret
properties.description: Shared secret the Telegram bot sends in x-grpc-shared-secret (SharedSecretAuthInterceptor). At least 16 characters and not a dev default outside the dev/test profiles (SecretsValidator).

properties.name: app.notifications.unsubscribe-secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 key signing the unsubscribe links of notification emails (EmailPreferences). At least 32 bytes outside the dev/test profiles; changing it invalidates the links in emails already sent.

properties.name: app.notifications.poll-delay-ms
properties.description: Delay in milliseconds between NotificationWorker polls of the outbox.

properties.name: app.notifications.purge-delay-ms
properties.description: Delay in milliseconds between purges of failed outbox jobs and expired email budget entries.

properties.name: app.mail.retry.delay-ms
properties.description: Initial backoff in milliseconds of EmailService's retries of a failed SMTP send; doubles per attempt.

properties.name: app.auth.token-purge-delay-ms
properties.description: Delay in milliseconds between purges of expired Telegram link tokens (ExpiredTokenPurger).

properties.name: app.keycloak.deletion-delay-ms
properties.description: Delay in milliseconds between IdentityDeletionWorker runs, which delete the Keycloak users of deleted accounts.
